title: No Explanation Given
paragraphs: “I only heard a little, but her name is Atla-chan, right? Since she speaks politely like Yuki-chan, maybe that’s why they sound similar?”
“Probably. You’ll notice the difference eventually.”
“So, Queen, is there something about Fohl-san and Atla-san?” Itsuki asked the Queen.
The Queen hid her mouth with her fan, her eyes softening slightly.
“Well, yes. Explaining this will take some time, is that alright?”
“U-uh… sure.”
After receiving their consent, the Queen closed her fan and began to speak.
“My late husband, Aultcray, was originally named Lüge Lansarz Faubrey, the Staff Hero, and he had a much younger, blind sister.”
“A… blind sister…”

Father, along with Ren and Itsuki, shifted their gazes from the Queen to Fohl and his sister. What is this? Did Trash have some complicated background? I feel like I’ve heard something like this before, but my memory’s a bit hazy.
“There were various complications regarding Rouge’s lineage, but it’s not necessary to go into detail here.”
“Is that so?”
“Then I shall tell you. Rouge’s real name was Lüge Lansarz Faubrey. He was the thirtieth prince in line for the throne of Faubrey.”
“So he was originally a prince of Faubrey? Well, with that many royals around, it’s not surprising something like that happened.”
Father and the others nodded in understanding. Well, a lot happened in Faubrey.
“Yes, he was the youngest. However, an incident occurred that led to his disinheritance. His parents and those close to him were massacred by the Hakuko race.”
“What a turbulent life he’s had.”
“Sounds like something straight out of an anime.”

“Fortunately, Rouge and his sister weren’t present at the scene and survived, but for political reasons, Faubrey did not pursue justice with Siltvelt over the incident. Because of that, Rouge harbored a deep grudge against both Faubrey and Siltvelt and moved to our country, which opposed demi-humans, changing his name in the process.”
“Ah, so that’s why he hated Naofumi, the Shield Hero.”
“We’ve uncovered other reasons in previous loops.”
I believe it was in the last or the one before that when I heard it slip from Fiancée. His son was also killed by Siltvelt, huh.
“Now that you mention it, Motoyasu mentioned that before.”
“So? What does that have to do with Atla-san?”
Itsuki pressed on for the core of the story.

“To Rouge, his blind sister was so precious that he wouldn’t have hesitated to give his life for her. However, she was supposedly killed by the Hakuko race… enough blood was left at the scene to suggest she was dead. This event fueled Rouge’s desire for revenge, and after many years, he eventually defeated the Hakuko who ruled Siltvelt.”
“Ah… I see.”
Ren nodded repeatedly, as if understanding the situation.
“Yes, as the heroes have surmised, Atla-san’s face is the spitting image of Rouge’s beloved sister, Lucia.”
Oh… come to think of it, Trash reconciled with Father after Fohl’s sister died.
“So that means Fohl-san and Atla-san might be the children of that king’s sister, right?”
“Yeah. It’s highly possible, isn’t it?”
At this point, Fohl and his sister looked a bit troubled.
“No… even if you say that, I don’t know much about my mother’s background.”
“Mother? She passed away before I was old enough to remember, so I don’t know much.”
So they’re related to Trash, huh. Now that I think about it, after the war with Faubrey, Trash started looking out for Fohl. I remember Fohl clinging to Father, crying.
“Motoyasu-kun, don’t just stand there acting like it’s none of your business. Remember this properly. If things go well, you might be able to convince that king.”
“Is that so?”
“Yes, if Aultcray had seen them while he was alive… maybe he would have softened his stance toward Iwatani-sama a little.”
Oh, the Queen and Father had been asking me what to do about Trash, so this is a good opportunity.
“Understood. If there’s a next time, I’ll make sure to remember this.”
“If that king realizes that the children of his fated enemy’s offspring look just like his sister… maybe he’ll finally step up and act like the Staff Hero.”
“Yeah. Otherwise, Melromarc wouldn’t have had to suffer so much… right?”
“It’s not impossible. Considering that princess… who knows how much she would use the king… even with knowledge of the future, it’s hard to say if we could do anything about it.”
Ren and Itsuki began discussing the situation. Well, this is probably something that should be remembered too. The Crimson Swine, huh? I’ll definitely kill her, so that won’t be a problem.
“What do you think you’re making Atla do!?”
At this point, Father tried to take a step back to explain the situation.

He’s probably being cautious because if he gets too close, he might get ‘dug into.’ I won’t let Father do something he hates! If anyone dares to force such a thing, they’ll pay for it with their life.
“There’s no problem, Fohl-san. This isn’t about the current you.”
“Huh?”
Fohl, still carrying his sister on his back, tilted his head the entire time. Just as Itsuki was about to open his mouth to explain, Father stopped him and whispered quietly.
“If I explain it in detail, Fohl-kun will probably get angrier. It’s better not to explain.”
“I see. That’s true.”
“It’s like asking him to show his sister to a stranger. And she’s already dead. I doubt he’d believe the circumstances.”
“Exactly. When the time comes, just say it’s to show her to his relatives. Right, Motoyasu-kun?”
“Understood.”
So, we’re supposed to show Fohl’s sister to Trash, huh. Will that alone make Trash reconcile with Father like in the first world? I have my doubts.

“We’ve gotten pretty off-topic, but Ren, Itsuki… I have a lot of work to do in Melromarc before I leave for the Nosferatu Great Forest, so I’m counting on you guys to help Fohl-kun and the others level up.”
“Of course. We’ll also take care of the requests from Faubrey while we’re at it.”

And so, another week passed while we continued searching for Filo-tan’s egg in parallel with looking for the sister. According to Father, he plans to raise her quickly using the Nosferatu Great Forest, so the egg hasn’t hatched yet. Same as back on Cal Mira Island. As for the search for the sister, there’s still no news. Father managed to gather a few of the slaves he had been managing, but perhaps because of the Crimson Swine’s vengeful spirit incident, the discovery rate has been disappointing. Rather, a considerable number of nobles, slaves, and civilians have died because of that Crimson Swine. The root cause of everything is the Crimson Swine.
Father was staring intently at the sister’s older sister with a serious expression. Currently, we’re staying in a room the Queen had prepared.
“Sadeena-san, you’ve been pushing yourself too hard lately. Take care, okay!”
The sister’s older sister has been taking care of the rescued slaves. Apparently, she also went on a light hunting trip with Father and made a reckless charge.
“Oh dear, I’ve been scolded by the little one. Cough”
However, it seems that the sister’s older sister has been feeling a bit under the weather lately and occasionally coughs.
“Seriously… it’s great that sea monsters give more experience than expected, but… they’re just as strong to make up for it.”

Father had been discussing things a few times regarding underwater matters. The sister’s older sister’s mobility underwater is truly remarkable. It seems this time, she had been charging in recklessly as if venting her frustrations.
“Hey…”
“Hm?”
At that moment, Assistant tugged at the hem of Father’s clothes and asked.
“What’s wrong, Wyndia-chan?”
“You’re going far away again soon, right?”
“Yes, that’s right. I’m thinking of having you, Sadeena-san’s village kids, and soldiers from various countries help with leveling up.”
“Yeah, that’s fine, but…”
Assistant was looking off into the distance for some reason.
“What is it?”
